title: Does the Prompt-based Large Language Model Recognize Students’ Demographics and Introduce Bias in Essay Scoring?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to infer the student's gender based on their written essay, assigning an automated score to the essay, and then evaluating scoring fairness between male and female students by analyzing automated scoring errors using metrics such as Overall Score Accuracy (OSA), Overall Score Difference (OSD), Conditional Score Difference (CSD), and Mean Absolute Error Difference (MAED).

Prompting the LLM to infer the student's first-language background (native vs. non-native English speaker) from their essay, generating an automated essay score, and then measuring scoring bias using fairness metrics (OSA, OSD, CSD, MAED) alongside multivariate regression analysis to see if scoring errors increase when the model correctly identifies the student as non-native.
